label: RADAR system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a restriction by an adenosine deaminase acting on RNA locus encoding an RdrA AAA+ ATPase and an RdrB adenosine deaminase that assemble into a supramolecular defense complex to modify adenosine-containing substrates and inhibit bacteriophage replication.
exact_synonyms: restriction by an adenosine deaminase acting on RNA
observations: RADAR branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual rdrA or rdrB genes, RdrA or RdrB proteins, RdrA/RdrB supramolecular-complex assembly, ATP-to-ITP conversion or RNA editing without a complete antiphage locus, exact RdrA activation triggers, source database rows naming one RADAR locus, substrate-specific RADAR subtypes, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, Gabija, Hachiman, Shedu, Thoeris, Zorya, Kiwa, PARIS, phosphorothioate defense, CRISPR-Cas, and abortive infection families.
